title: Consider pickers for medium-to-long lists

statement.en: Consider a picker for a medium-to-long list of distinct choices.
statement.ja: medium-to-longなdistinct choiceのlistにはpickerを検討する。

conditions: A picker helps people scroll efficiently through more choices than a short menu should contain.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Pickers experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるPickersの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Order picker values predictably

statement.en: Use predictable, logically ordered picker values.

conditions: Help people infer hidden values and move through them quickly.
Account for system ordering based on device language or location.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Pickers experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Avoid switching views for a picker

statement.en: Avoid switching views solely to show a picker.
statement.ja: pickerを表示するためだけのview切替を避ける。

conditions: Display the picker in context below or near the field people are editing.
A picker commonly appears at the bottom of a window or in a popover.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Pickers experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Consider coarser minute intervals

statement.en: Consider less granular minute intervals when minute-by-minute date-picker precision is unnecessary.
statement.ja: minute単位のdate-picker precisionが不要な場合は粗いminute intervalを検討する。

conditions: The default minute list contains values from 0 through 59.
If increasing the interval, choose a value that divides evenly into 60.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Pickers experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるPickersの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Use compact date pickers in constrained space

statement.en: Use a compact iOS or iPadOS date picker when space is constrained.
statement.ja: spaceが限られる場合はcompactなiOSまたはiPadOS date pickerを使う。

conditions: The compact button shows the current value and opens a modal calendar and time editor.
Let people make multiple edits before tapping outside the modal view to confirm them.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Pickers experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Choose a suitable macOS date-picker style

statement.en: Choose a macOS date-picker style that suits the app’s space and selection task.
statement.ja: appのspaceとselection taskに合うmacOS date-picker styleを選ぶ。

conditions: Use textual style for limited space and specific date or time selections.
Use graphical style for calendar browsing, date ranges, or an appropriate clock-face appearance.

title: Consider pull-down buttons for short lists

statement.en: For a fairly short choice list, consider a pull-down button instead of a picker.
statement.ja: fairly shortなchoice listにはpickerではなくpull-down buttonを検討する。

conditions: A picker would add too much visual weight for the small number of choices.

title: Keep countdown date pickers within supported limits

statement.en: Keep iOS and iPadOS countdown-timer picker values at or below 23 hours and 59 minutes.
statement.ja: iOSおよびiPadOSのcountdown-timer picker valueを23時間59分以下に保つ。

conditions: Use a wheels style because countdown-timer mode is unavailable in inline and compact styles.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Pickers experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
